comparison.objective: Grate cheese while keeping a loose box grater stable; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand braces a body against linear rubbing force while the other performs repeated pressed strokes; candidate applies concentric screw/nut countertorque to preserve an angular setting.
comparison.success_condition: Specified grated mass/downstroke with grater upright and released versus locked 90° stop, bounded drift, three cycles, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual reaction management, but the tested contact mechanics and retained outcomes differ substantially.
